name: @treaty/jsx
description: Ambient JSX types and automatic-runtime entry for Treaty's selectorless, signal-aware, standalone JSX authoring format. Ships the global JSX namespace so projects never hand-copy a treaty-jsx.d.ts; the @treaty/lsp language server auto-provides these types. Also ships the authoring-format module shims (*.treaty / *.tjsx) via the ./ambient entry so apps never hand-declare them.
author: Jordan Hall
